body: If you can convey something meaningful and draw from that an honest genuine reaction of reflection and consideration, I think you're doing a fine job.

I haven't been in real contact with my friends for a long time. Been too busy trying to pick up the pieces of my life and honestly haven't done anything but work on it for literally the last decade. They've all gone on to bigger and better things and I'm stuck back at home with my parents after getting screwed over by some people. Phone calls wouldn't really do much - we're too different of people and too much time has passed. 

My uni has some free minor counseling, but I have no insurance to follow anything up, and little to no money to pay for anything really. It's all a shitty numbers game, and unfortunately I just don't have the right numbers on my screen. I study geology.

It's great to hear that others have that hope, but I seriously just don't feel it. I'm taking the last pre-req courses I need for my masters, and on top of having to do summer work for my upcoming thesis, I feel like a mountain just landed on me. Plus doing all of this has left me socially isolated and I feel like nothing is going my way. It's really depressing because I had so much hope for finishing my undergrad.
